cards.card_text: Then Jesus says they've heard it was said to the ancients, “Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.” Friend, I've promised bakers “cookies in five minutes” so many times, the TIMER stopped believing me.
cards.verse_text: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
cards.snippet: …said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’

cards.card_text: To keep a vow he had made To mark his last day in Corinth To get ready for the long voyage
cards.verse_text: He had his head shaved in Cenchrea to keep a vow he had made, and then he sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila.
cards.snippet: He had his head shaved in Cenchrea to keep a vow he had made, and then he sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla…

cards.card_text: The elders ask, "What then should we do?" Those thousands of Jewish believers will certainly hear that Paul has come, so the elders have a plan, and it starts with four men who have taken a vow.
cards.verse_text: There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
cards.snippet: There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
